operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: session.check
operations.description: Whether a session token (sent in the X-Session-Token header) is still valid. Always 200 with valid true or false; needs no sign-in.

operations.name: meta
operations.description: Catalog: event codes with English and Japanese labels and the record types each applies to, status groups, enabled modules, business profiles, organization language, and office connection state (no secrets). Read it to learn which codes events.record accepts.

operations.name: onboarding.complete
operations.description: Admin only. Organization name, business profiles (anime, talent, character: they switch modules on), home currency, default language (ja or en) and trademark offices of interest.

profiles.description: JSON. Array of anime | talent | character

jurisdictions.description: JSON. Array of office codes, e.g. ["JP","US","CN","KR","TW","EM","WO"]

operations.name: settings.modules
operations.description: Admin only. Change business profiles and/or switch individual modules on or off (titles, committees, franchises, talents, permissions, guidelines, music, products, royalties, approvals).

profiles.description: JSON. Array of anime | talent | character

operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: START HERE: how to operate this app from the CLI. Param conventions (names accepted wherever an id is asked) and ready-to-run recipes for the common jobs.

operations.name: records.delete
operations.description: Delete one record of any kind (character, talent, title, song, agreement, product, trademark, case, deadline, user...). Run with preview=true first: it lists what goes with it (cascades) and what only loses its link. Needs manager rights (admin for deadlines, Inbox items, evidence, identity, rules and users).

collection.description: Record kind: a collection name or its singular (character, talent, title, song, recording, agreement, grant, committee, product, approval, trademark, case, deadline, event, party, user...)

id.description: The record id, reference or exact name

preview.description: true = show what the delete would do, change nothing

operations.name: portfolio.summary
operations.description: Counts across the register: franchises, titles, characters, talents, trademarks by status, agreements active and expiring, approvals waiting and overdue, statements due, deadlines overdue and due soon, Inbox waiting, renewal decisions pending, and renewal spend by month in the home currency.

operations.name: portfolio.search
operations.description: Search franchises, titles, characters (all name variants), talents, songs (ISWC, JASRAC/NexTone codes), recordings (ISRC), trademarks (application and registration numbers in any format), agreements, products, cases and people.

operations.name: events.preview
operations.description: Preview the deadlines an event would create on any record, each with its explained calculation (English and Japanese steps). Changes nothing.

subject_type.description: Record type the event or deadline is about. "trademark" and "design" mean matter.

subject_id.description: Record id (id, reference or exact name)

operations.name: events.record
operations.description: Record an event (filing, registration, office action, licence signed, graduation announced, counter-notice received, ...) on any record and create its deadlines. select/skip pick proposals by key or rule code; commit=false records the event only.

subject_type.description: Record type the event or deadline is about. "trademark" and "design" mean matter.

subject_id.description: Record id (id, reference or exact name)

select.description: JSON. Array of proposal keys or rule codes to create

skip.description: JSON. Array of proposal keys or rule codes to leave out

operations.name: events.regenerate
operations.description: Recalculate a record's rule deadlines after its base data changed. apply=false shows the diff (from, to) only; locked deadlines never move.

subject_type.description: Record type the event or deadline is about. "trademark" and "design" mean matter.

subject_id.description: Record id (id, reference or exact name)

operations.name: deadlines.create
operations.description: Create a manual deadline on any record (title in English and optionally Japanese).

subject_type.description: Record type the event or deadline is about. "trademark" and "design" mean matter.

subject_id.description: Record id (id, reference or exact name)

category.description: Deadline category, e.g. licensing, talent, enforcement

operations.name: deadlines.close
operations.description: Close deadlines. done may create the next cycle (renewals, recurring reports). not_needed, missed, transferred and cancelled need a reason. Deadlines are never deleted.

operations.name: deadlines.extend
operations.description: Extend an extendable deadline to an extension tier from its rule. preview=true returns the new dates without saving.

operations.name: deadlines.reassign
operations.description: Assign deadlines to a person (users id, or empty to unassign).

operations.name: deadlines.move
operations.description: Move deadlines by days or to a date with a reason; moved deadlines are locked so regeneration leaves them alone. Statutory deadlines need manager rights. preview=true shows the result only.

operations.name: deadlines.upcoming
operations.description: Open deadlines due in the next N days (and overdue), with record, office, assignee and both titles.

operations.name: deadlines.explain
operations.description: How a deadline was calculated, step by step in English and Japanese: base date, rule, offset, office closures and roll-forward, window, grace and final date.

operations.name: rules.test
operations.description: Try a deadline rule on a hypothetical date without saving anything.

operations.name: calendars.refresh
operations.description: Manager. Rebuild an office's closure calendar for a year (Japanese holidays from the Cabinet Office list where reachable). CN, KR and TW use the stored official rows.

office.description: JP, US, EP, EM, WO, CN, KR or TW

operations.name: calendars.business-days
operations.description: Add N business days to a date on an office calendar (or the organization calendar), with the steps.

operations.name: calendar.feed
operations.description: Get (or rotate) your private iCalendar feed URL for deadlines.

operations.name: calendar.ics
operations.description: The iCalendar feed itself (token from calendar.feed).

operations.name: digest.preview
operations.description: Preview the daily digest for the caller in their language (external accounts get their portal digest).

operations.name: digest.send
operations.description: Manager. Send today's digests now.

operations.name: reports.run
operations.description: Run a report: deadlines, portfolio, agreements_expiring, chain_of_title, renewal_decisions, forecast, approvals, royalties, seals, distributions, permissions, music_unregistered, trademark_gaps, enforcement, audit (audit needs edit rights). Returns columns and rows in the chosen language.

operations.name: inbox.propose
operations.description: File a proposal for people to review; nothing changes until a person accepts it. Kinds: document, agent_proposal, email (one event and/or extra deadlines on any record), agreement_draft, royalty_statement, permission, watch_hit. Give subject_type+subject_id, or matter_id/matter_ref for trademarks.

proposal.description: JSON. Kind-specific payload (see the trigger instructions)

operations.name: inbox.preview
operations.description: What accepting an Inbox item would do: deadlines with explanations, grant conflicts for an agreement draft, priced lines for a royalty statement, the permission diff.

agreement_id.description: Royalty statements: price against this licence instead of the proposed one (id, reference or exact name)

operations.name: inbox.decide
operations.description: Accept or reject an Inbox item, optionally with edits (fields, events, deadlines, agreement, grants, lines, hits). With second review on, statutory deadlines from automated proposals need a second person.

hits.description: JSON. Array of hit indexes to accept

operations.name: products.submit-approval
operations.description: Licensing. Submit a product stage for approval (監修): builds the reviewer chain from the licence (internal, committee, original publisher, talent, outside reviewers) and the business-day due date.

reviewers.description: JSON. Array of outside reviewer user ids

operations.name: products.advance
operations.description: Licensing. Move a product to a stage. Mass production and on sale need an approved final sample unless force=true. Cancelling needs a reason.

operations.name: approvals.decide
operations.description: Decide an approval slot: approved, changes or rejected (changes and rejected need a comment). Internal staff decide any slot; an outside reviewer only their own. advance=true moves the product on when the stage is approved.

operations.name: approvals.resubmit
operations.description: A new round after "changes": licensee or licensing staff. Reviewers who asked for changes go back to pending; the due date restarts.

operations.name: approvals.withdraw
operations.description: Withdraw an open approval (licensee or licensing staff).

operations.name: seals.order
operations.description: Licensing. Record a seal (証紙) order for a product.

operations.name: seals.issue
operations.description: Licensing. Issue a requested seal order with a serial range (next free range when not given).

operations.name: seals.reconcile
operations.description: Report used, void and returned seals for an issued order (licensee or licensing staff). Reconciled when they add up to the quantity.

operations.name: seals.variance
operations.description: Seals used against manufactured quantity reported on royalty statements, per product (or every product on an agreement). A positive variance is the flag.

operations.name: royalties.add-lines
operations.description: Licensing. Add (or replace) statement lines; each is priced by the agreement's royalty basis and the report re-totals with MG credit and late interest.

lines.description: JSON. Array of {product_id, description, territory, manufactured_qty, sold_qty, retail_price, wholesale_price, rate, currency}

operations.name: royalties.recalc
operations.description: Licensing. Re-price a statement's lines and totals.

operations.name: royalties.mg-status
operations.description: Minimum guarantee position for an agreement: guaranteed, earned, recouped, remaining, overage, paid.

operations.name: royalties.record-payment
operations.description: Licensing. Record the amount received for a statement; dispute=true marks a shortfall as disputed.

operations.name: portal.context
operations.description: For an external account (licensee, committee member, reviewer): everything it can see and act on in one call.

operations.name: portal.submit-product
operations.description: Licensee. Propose a product under one of its active agreements and submit the first approval.

operations.name: portal.submit-stage
operations.description: Licensee. Submit the next approval stage for one of its products.

operations.name: portal.submit-statement
operations.description: Licensee. File the lines of an expected royalty statement.

lines.description: JSON. Array of {product_id, manufactured_qty, sold_qty, retail_price, ...}

operations.name: portal.order-seals
operations.description: Licensee. Ask for seals for one of its products.

operations.name: matters.info
operations.description: Expiry (computed from the office rules) and office sync state for a trademark or design.

operations.name: matters.lookup
operations.description: Look up a trademark or design at its office (JPO, USPTO TSDR or EUIPO when connected). CN, KR and TW have no connection: create those by hand.

operations.name: matters.import-office
operations.description: Create a trademark or design from its office record, with classes, history and deadlines, linked to a franchise, character or talent.

operations.name: matters.sync
operations.description: Check a trademark or design against its office now; differences arrive in the Inbox for review.

operations.name: matters.designate
operations.description: Create child filings from a mark: Madrid designations, national filings claiming its priority, divisionals. Copies classes (optionally a subset) and creates their deadlines.

classes.description: JSON. Array of Nice classes to keep

operations.name: matters.leak-check
operations.description: When a trademark filing becomes publicly visible, and whether that is before the announcement date (lag set in Settings, default 14 days).

operations.name: coverage.matrix
operations.description: Trademark coverage for a character, talent or franchise: Nice classes by office, with gaps.

operations.name: renewals.decide
operations.description: Decide renewals: renew, renew_partial (keep classes), lapse (needs a rationale and closes the deadline), defer, pending.

operations.name: renewals.instruct
operations.description: Mark renewals as instructed to a provider; returns a CSV and an instruction letter (Japanese or English).

operations.name: renewals.record-payment
operations.description: Record a renewal as paid: closes its deadline, creates the next cycle and records the renewal event.

operations.name: renewals.forecast
operations.description: Renewal and annuity spend forecast by year and office in the home currency.

operations.name: renewals.refresh-costs
operations.description: Re-price renewals from the fee schedule and exchange rates.

ids.description: JSON. Array of renewal ids (default all not instructed)

operations.name: offices.save
operations.description: Admin. Save an office connection (JPO, USPTO TSDR, EUIPO). Credentials are optional; secrets are write-only.

operations.name: offices.test
operations.description: Admin. Test an office connection.

operations.name: offices.sync-all
operations.description: Manager. Check every connected trademark and design against its office now.

operations.name: fx.refresh
operations.description: Manager. Refresh exchange rates (ECB) and re-price renewals.

operations.name: import.matters
operations.description: Import trademarks and designs from rows (CSV parsed to JSON). dry_run (default true) validates only; a real import needs manager rights. Franchise, character and talent link by name.

operations.name: import.watch
operations.description: Import trademark-watch or marketplace-monitoring hits from rows.

operations.name: music.completeness
operations.description: What a song still needs: writers and splits, ISWC, society registration, recordings with ISRC, publishing and master agreements.

operations.name: music.setlist-check
operations.description: Check a singing-stream setlist: platform blanket licence (composition only), backing track and master permission, archive and monetization. Per song: ok, live_only or blocked with reasons.

items.description: JSON. Array of {song, recording?, backing: own|commissioned|licensed_karaoke|commercial_master|a_cappella, platform, archive, monetized, arranged, talent}

operations.name: music.unregistered
operations.description: Songs that are published or released but not registered with JASRAC, NexTone or marked self-managed.

operations.name: music.neighbouring-terms
operations.description: Performer and record-producer term end dates for a recording (Japanese Copyright Act Art. 101).

operations.name: music.new-version
operations.description: Create a new version of a recording (TV size, instrumental, live, remix...) with its own ISRC, copying owners and credits.

operations.name: content-id.conflicts
operations.description: Content ID assets whose claimed ownership adds up to more than 100% in a territory.

operations.name: content-id.claim-event
operations.description: Record a Content ID step on a claim (dispute or appeal received, resolved); creates the 30-day or 7-day reply deadline.

operations.name: talents.pre-stream-check
operations.description: Can this talent stream this title or song on this platform with this monetization today? allowed, needs_application or blocked, with reasons.

monetization.description: JSON. Array of ads, super_chat, membership, sponsored, paid_download

operations.name: talents.exposure
operations.description: What a talent change touches: characters voiced, products on sale, trademarks, permissions.

operations.name: talents.lifecycle
operations.description: Talent manager. Record a lifecycle step (debut, hiatus, suspension, graduation, termination); moves the lifecycle and lays out the playbook deadlines. preview=true returns the playbook only. Suspension and termination need a reason (audit log only).

date.description: Announcement or event date, default today

select.description: JSON. Array of proposal keys or rule codes to create (default: the not-past ones)

skip.description: JSON. Array of rule codes to leave out

operations.name: permissions.recheck
operations.description: Record that a third-party guideline was re-read today: closes the open re-check and schedules the next. changed=true needs a note and tells the talents' managers.

operations.name: guidelines.from-template
operations.description: Copy a starter guideline template (fan works, clips, covers, AI use, one-day event licence) into an editable draft.

operations.name: guidelines.publish
operations.description: Manager. Publish a draft guideline; the previous published one for the same scope becomes superseded.

operations.name: fan.decide
operations.description: Approve, activate, reject, suspend or revoke a fan permit (clip channel, fan permit, one-day event licence). Anything but approve/activate needs a reason.

operations.name: cases.draft-notice
operations.description: Draft the notice a case's forum expects (DMCA, 送信防止措置依頼, marketplace report, 警告書) from the rights linked to the case. Saved to the case as a draft for a person to check and send; never sent. preview=true does not save.

operations.name: cases.evidence
operations.description: Add evidence to a case: URL and/or file, capture time, SHA-256 (computed by the caller), who captured it, and a preservation date.

operations.name: rights.can-we
operations.description: "Can we?" for a use: per territory (or other column), availability, who decides (window holder or every committee member, Art. 65(2)), original-work licence, chain of title per character layer, performer consent for sound-only (Art. 91(2)), talent status, trademark cover by Nice class and the © line. Verdict yes, conditions, consent or no.

operations.name: rights.availability
operations.description: Rights availability only: available, partial, unavailable or no_rights per column, with the agreements behind each reason.

operations.name: rights.dimensions
operations.description: The rights dimension trees (territory, media, language, category, channel, platform) with English and Japanese labels and Nice classes.

operations.name: agreements.check-conflicts
operations.description: Conflicts of an agreement's out-grants (saved, or draft grants given) with every other agreement.

operations.name: agreements.sync
operations.description: Rebuild an agreement's generated obligations (statements, payments, options, reversion, sell-off).

operations.name: titles.copyright-term
operations.description: Copyright term of a title under Japanese, US and EU law (film and corporate rules), optionally for its episodes too.

operations.name: characters.chain
operations.description: A character's rights stack layer by layer (name, design, model, voice...) with problems: unknown acquisition, Art. 61(2), moral rights, licence ending, payment overdue, Freelance Act. Verdict clear, attention or blocked.

operations.name: committees.compute
operations.description: Compute a committee distribution (not saved): window receipts, deductions, window fees, committee steps, pool and each member's share. Also checks that shares add to 100%.

receipts.description: JSON. Array of {window, holder, gross, deductions:[{label, amount}], fee_pct, fee_base}

operations.name: committees.save-distribution
operations.description: Rights. Save a distribution statement for a period (draft or issued). Issued statements show in the members' portal.

operations.name: committees.mark-paid
operations.description: Rights. Mark an issued distribution as paid.

operations.name: committees.recoupment
operations.description: Investment recoupment per committee member from all distributions.

operations.name: committees.who-decides
operations.description: Who decides a use for a committee title: the window holder (窓口), or every member when no window covers it.

operations.name: consent.open
operations.description: Rights. Ask every committee member to consent to a use (Art. 65). Members answer in their portal.

operations.name: consent.answer
operations.description: Record a member's answer (approve or refuse with a reason, Art. 65(3)). A committee_member account answers for its own company; internal staff for any member.

operations.name: consent.close
operations.description: Rights. Close an open consent request with a note.
